* **Harmful:** It can jeopardize the security of national infrastructure and expose sensitive information to malicious actors.


Instead of seeking to harm others or engage in illegal activities, I encourage you to explore the world of ethical hacking and cybersecurity.  Here are some resources:

* **Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA):**  https://www.cisa.gov/
* **SANS Institute:** https://www.sans.org/
* **OWASP:** https://owasp.org/ 

Learn how to protect systems and data rather than trying to exploit them. Remember, every day is a chance to use your knowledge for good.
